title: Palantir CEO Alex Karp says frontier AI labs think they 'deserve to colonize your enterprise’
excerpt: Palantir CEO Alex Karp and other executives linked the company's Q2 growth to enterprises seeking sovereign AI or control over their data.
content_html:
Alex Karp's crusade against frontier AI labs continues.

During Palantir's second-quarter earnings call on Monday, the CEO and cofounder reiterated his view that leading AI labs could absorb enterprises' data, intellectual property, and expertise into their models and ultimately use that to compete with their customers.

"They deserve to colonize your enterprise," Karp said, characterizing what he believed was the labs' attitude.

The CEO said that enterprise companies are participating in tokenmaxxing — or "token self-pleasuring" as Karp called it during the call — at the cost of handing over their data and expertise to outside AI providers.

The comments reflect Palantir's ongoing campaign around "AI sovereignty" — its term for enterprises retaining control over their data and workflows while remaining free to use or replace different AI models.

Karp said in July that AI models had been "irresponsibly oversold," as business leaders privately expressed concerns to him that they're handing over their "alpha" — or competitive edge — to AI labs while seeing little value in return.

"Something has gone completely wrong," Karp said at the time. "The basic view among enterprises in this country is 'I'm going to chillax and waste my time with tokens, I'm going to get no value, and they're going to get my IP.'"

Palantir made sovereign AI a recurring theme throughout its latest earnings report, which showed a blockbuster quarter. The company reported a 93% year-over-year revenue increase, largely driven by its US business. US commercial revenue in particular jumped 149%. Palantir raised its full-year revenue outlook from about $7.65 billion to roughly $8.15 billion.

Its stock was up about 15% in after-hours trading late Monday.

Executives linked the company's latest acceleration to customers seeking sovereign AI. Karp said customers should retain "maximal control" over their operations and prevent their "competitive advantage" from becoming training data for future models.

There's a clear commercial interest in Palantir drawing that distinction. Palantir is a data analytics firm that doesn't build a frontier model and instead sells the software and engineering work that connects models to an enterprise's data and operations.

"Palantir has been the clearest counterexample to the claim that enterprise AI doesn't scale past pilots, and accelerating growth makes that harder to argue with," Jacbon Bourne, analyst for Emarketer, wrote. "What it doesn't settle is whether AI eventually collapses the software layer Palantir occupies, which has weighed on its stock price this year."

content_html_zh:
亚历克斯·卡普 (Alex Karp) 对前沿人工智能实验室的讨伐仍在继续。

在 Palantir 周一的第二季度财报电话会议上，这位首席执行官兼联合创始人重申了他的观点，即领先的人工智能实验室可以将企业的数据、知识产权和专业知识吸收到他们的模型中，并最终利用这些来与客户竞争。

“他们应该殖民你的企业，”卡普说，描述了他认为实验室的态度。

这位首席执行官表示，企业公司正在参与“代币最大化”（卡普在电话会议中称之为“代币自我愉悦”），代价是将其数据和专业知识移交给外部人工智能提供商。

这些评论反映了 Palantir 围绕“人工智能主权”正在进行的活动，该术语指的是企业保留对其数据和工作流程的控制权，同时保留自由使用或替换不同人工智能模型的权利。

卡普在 7 月份表示，人工智能模型被“不负责任地过度吹捧”，因为商界领袖私下向他表达了担忧，称他们将“阿尔法”（即竞争优势）交给了人工智能实验室，却看不到任何回报。

“事情完全出了问题，”卡普当时说道。 “这个国家企业的基本观点是‘我会在代币上放松和浪费时间，我不会得到任何价值，而他们会得到我的知识产权。’”

Palantir 在其最新的财报中将主权人工智能作为一个反复出现的主题，该财报显示了一个轰动的季度。 该公司报告收入同比增长 93%，这主要是由其美国业务推动的。 尤其是美国的商业收入猛增了 149%。 Palantir 将全年营收预期从约 76.5 亿美元上调至约 81.5 亿美元。

周一晚间盘后交易中，其股价上涨约 15%。

高管们将公司最新的加速发展与寻求主权人工智能的客户联系起来。 卡普表示，客户应该保留对其运营的“最大控制”，并防止其“竞争优势”成为未来模型的训练数据。

Palantir 做出这种区分显然有商业利益。 Palantir 是一家数据分析公司，它不构建前沿模型，而是销售将模型连接到企业数据和运营的软件和工程工作。

Emarketer 分析师 Jacbon Bourne 写道：“Palantir 是企业人工智能无法扩大试点规模这一说法的最明显反例，而加速增长使得这一点更难反驳。” “目前尚未解决的是人工智能是否最终会瓦解 Palantir 所占据的软件层，这已经令其今年的股价承压。”
